fields.summary: Filter operational customer records by source and update time
fields.description:
As a customer operations analyst, I want to filter the ODL customers read API by source system and updated-since, so that I can reconcile just the records changed in the system I am investigating. Today a full export makes reconciliation slow and mixes unrelated source records.

Acceptance criteria
- [ ] A source-system filter returns only customers from that source.
- [ ] An updated-since timestamp returns only records updated after that instant, consistently across time zones.
- [ ] Combining the filters applies both restrictions while preserving pagination.
- [ ] Unknown sources return an empty list and malformed timestamps return an actionable client error.

fields.summary: Prevent backdated billing plan changes from creating overlapping subscriptions
fields.description:
As a billing operations owner, I want invalid effective dates rejected when changing a tenant's plan, so that subscription history remains trustworthy. The billing-service POST /api/tenants/{tenant_id}/plan-change request includes effective_on. A date before the existing subscription starts can currently be accepted and leave conflicting plan history.

Acceptance criteria
- [ ] An effective_on before the current subscription starts is rejected with a clear client error.
- [ ] A rejected request leaves subscription dates, statuses and row counts unchanged.
- [ ] A valid future effective_on closes the prior subscription the day before and starts the selected plan on that date.
- [ ] Repeating the same accepted request does not create a second plan change.

fields.summary: Make the search no-results browser check reliable on busy CI workers
fields.description:
As the release owner, I want the Search Page check 'shows no results for gibberish query' in frontend/client-app/e2e/search.spec.ts to give a reliable release signal. In this demo's CI scenario the check intermittently times out waiting for the no-results or loading state on busy workers, while an immediate retry succeeds. This is a seeded investigation scenario, not a verified historical CI incident.

Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Repeated runs on a throttled CI worker reach a conclusive no-results state for xyznonexistent9999.
- [ ] A failed search request produces a clear failing assertion instead of a successful loading-only check.
- [ ] A genuine matching result still causes the no-results check to fail.
- [ ] The check remains reliable without blanket retries or an arbitrary long sleep.
